name: Genesis-1
about: Genesis-1 (2006-029A), a station core, launched 2006 Jul 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2006 Jul 19), held fixed

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
